name: recruiter-inbox
description: An actor agent for recruiter conversations on LinkedIn and email. Sweeps LinkedIn messages and InMails in your signed-in Chrome and recruiter email in Gmail, triages each one, drafts the reply that moves it toward a first call, and sends only the text you approved word for word; a hook stops anything else. Tracks who owes whom a reply. Use when answering recruiters, LinkedIn job offer messages, salary questions or follow-ups.
